newsitem.title: UK: Stolt Parcel Tankers takes delivery of new tanker.
newsitem.headline: Stolt Parcel Tankers takes delivery of new tanker.

text.p: Stolt Parcel Tankers said Thursday it took delivery of a new chemical parcel tanker.
The company, part of the Stolt-Nielsen SA group, said Danish shipbuilder Danyard delivered the 37,000 dwt Stolt Innovation, the third in a series of seven chemical parcel tankers Stolt ordered.
Four of the series are being built by Danyard and the other three will be built by the Societe Nouvelle des Ateliers et Chantiers du Havre yard in Le Havre, France.

Stolt said the ships are designed to carry the full range of specialty chemicals and are the first chemical tankers to be fitted with more environmentally friendly medium-speed diesel-electric propulsion instead of conventional slow-speed diesel engines. --Reuters Shipping News + 44 171 542 4087
